lore_anchors.definition: The pinnacle of Ki Refining in the Three Realms, a supreme being who dictates the laws of the Heaven and Earth and commands immense cosmic power.
A cultivator who has successfully transcended the mortal tribulations and achieved a state of pure Yang, granting them a timeless existence.
The Fiendgod Body Refining equivalent of a True Immortal, a being with an indestructible, divine body.
The fourth major realm of Ki Refining, where a cultivator's internal world manifests stars, moons, and suns, granting vast power.
The unbreakable spiritual core and will of a cultivator. A strong Dao-heart is the foundation for withstanding the temptations and tribulations of the immortal path.
A True Immortal who has purified their soul and energy to the highest level, a step below a Daofather.
A second body created by a cultivator at the Primal Daoist stage, acting as an independent clone.
A powerful Empyrean God and Pure Yang True Immortal, known for his rough manners and direct speech.
The grand main hall of the Xia Emperor's court, where the highest powers of the realm gather.
A cultivation partner bound by a shared Dao-heart and lifetime commitment, more than a spouse.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Daofather Crimsonbright choose Mu Chuan Realperson over Ji Ning?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Daofather valued the unshakeable Dao-heart and patient temperament of Mu Chuan, believing that in the long path of immortality, a solid foundation and mental fortitude are more important than raw speed of cultivation.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is Ji Ning being punished for being too talented?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Not at all. The Daofather praised Ji Ning's talent and ordered him to be kept in the Crimsonbright lineage. The choice was simply about different philosophies of teaching and what the Daofather looked for in a direct disciple.

Lu Dongbin is a Pure Yang True Immortal and a peerless Sword Immortal with two Daofathers backing him. He recognized Ji Ning's unique potential and desperately wanted him as a disciple, but was refused by the Xia Emperor.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is Yu Wei being taken as a disciple by Lu Dongbin?
cultural_notes_faq.a: As a compromise to smooth over the political tension, the Xia Emperor allowed Lu Dongbin to choose any cultivator outside the top ninety-six. He chose Yu Wei, Ji Ning's Dao-companion, as a consolation prize.
